name: Management by Walking Around (MBWA)
excerpt: MBWA involves managers talking to employees to see how projects are progressing.
notes: Management by Walking Around (MBWA) is a management style where managers walk around in an unstructured manner through the workplace to check with employees and see how projects are progressing.
context_summary:
- Managers talk to employees.
- They check project progress.
- It is an unstructured management style.
